Welding Robot Operator

The company is looking for a Welding Robot Operator for the robotics department. In this role, you will be responsible for the automated welding process of high-quality stainless steel welded assemblies and will also perform various metalworking tasks. You will work in a production team with one or more welding robots, assessing and reworking products as needed. As a robot operator, you will monitor the functioning of the welding robots and the welding quality. The welds will be visually inspected, and any deviations will be monitored and discussed to ensure continuous process improvement. The plate thickness varies between 2 and 5 mm.
Team
There are different products: box frames, center arms, fences and grates, central units and boiler frames, collectors, M4use.
 What Will You Be Doing? 
▪ Operating and configuring the welding robot 
▪ Monitoring product quality 
▪ Improvement
What skills Do You need?
▪ You can weld in both Mig/Mag and Tig modes.
▪ Experience with welding robots.
▪ You are fluent in English.
▪ You are motivated and can work accurately.

What does the company offer?
    Salary between 20-21 euros gross/hour for 38 hours/week. With overtime (depending on client’s requirement): You can earn between 700-800 euros net/week (excluding housing and health insurance).
    Single Private Room in shared house
    Shared Company car or Travel allowance
    Weekly payment and long-term contract

AT The Family Business: 
    They have a close and friendly team where teamwork is key.
    They work with the best materials and state-of-the-art machinery in the safest and most organized work environment. They value order and cleanliness. 
    They manufacture high-quality products for special clients

The Analytical Center of Excellence (ACE) organization is looking for a 
Junior Analytical Technician 
(full shift) in the Chemicals lab located in Terneuzen, The Netherlands.
 

The Chemicals lab in is one of the Manufacturing Production Quality (MPQ) labs that performs analysis of plant-samples in Terneuzen. Servings multiple production plants such as polyurethanes and polyglycols results in the need for a 24/7 service and a full-shift roster to perform the analysis of all plant samples.
 

Responsibilities
 
 

• Ensure service requests are accurately run, and the data returned as per sample plan. 

• Analytical equipment operations and troubleshooting as per procedures. 

• Provide input of quality data into LIMS, document and communicate results. 

• Perform calibration and first line-maintenance of analytical equipment. Document/administrate these maintenance activities. Communicate maintenance work when required. 

• Apply Environmental Health & Safety (EH&S), Analytical Work Process and Operating Discipline/Quality System procedures and practices as well as cGMP/pharma standards. 

• Participating in and completing of laboratory training and corporate required trainings. 

• Co-operate and communicate with co-workers and clients to maintain workflow and instrumental information, and to share and leverage problem solving and prevention expertise. 

• Contribute to value creation by continuous improvement of procedures in the analytical work processes and related tools and performance metrics. 

• Promote a well-organized, responsive, efficient workplace and work well both as a team member and independently. 

Qualifications
 
 

• MBO-4 laboratory degree or similar (bachelors degree preferred). 

• Fluent in Dutch and English. 

• Experience in an industrial laboratory (analytical) 

• Able to work in full shift (24/7 roster): morning, afternoon and night shifts.  

 
 

Preferred qualifications
 
 

• GMP/pharma experience. 

• Experience in operation, calibration, maintenance and troubleshooting of analytical equipment. 

• Knowledge of quality data systems like LIMS, OpenLab, etc. 

• Good lab techniques, methodical record keeping, and the ability to work both independently and with co-workers. 

• Excellent human relations, organizational and communication skills are necessary to communicate with team members, partners and outside customers. 

• Exhibit confidence in confirming validity of methods and data. 

• Able to handle multiple tasks and work under pressure.

Mechanical engineer 

Description
• You prepare equipment specifications for pressure vessels, heat exchangers, pumps, etc.
• You recalculate pressure-retaining equipment according to construction codes such as AD2000 and ASME VIII.
• As an Equipment Engineer, you are familiar with the standards related to the above-mentioned activities.

Profile

• You have a minimum of 3 years of experience, preferably with chemical installations in an engineering environment.
• You show initiative and a sense of responsibility. 
• You are dynamic, precise, and have a keen eye for detail.
• As you frequently interact with clients, you possess strong communication skills.
• Required language skills: Dutch and English; German and/or French are an asset.

Production Employee 5-Shift System Zevenaar

As a production employee in a 5-shift system in Zevenaar, you will work in a dynamic environment where no days are the same.

In this role, you are responsible for ensuring the smooth running of the production process. You start your day with a brief handover from the previous shift, after which you operate and check the machines. Throughout the day, you monitor the quality of the products and resolve any issues. You ensure that the products are packed and prepared for shipment.

You will be working at a leading manufacturing company in Zevenaar. The organization is known for its innovative approach and strong focus on quality. With a team of committed employees, they strive to deliver the best products. The work atmosphere is informal and focused on collaboration, with plenty of room for personal development.

Inetum is a European leader in digital services. Every day, the Group's 28,000 consultants and specialists aim to make a digital impact for businesses, public sector bodies and society as a whole: solutions that contribute to performance, innovation and the common good.

Present in 19 countries, close to the regions, and with its major software publisher partners, Inetum meets the challenges of digital transformation with proximity and flexibility.

In response to a market that has been growing steadily for over 30 years, Inetum has made the deliberate choice to refocus on 4 core businesses in order to gain strength and offer customized solutions tailored to the specific needs of its customers: consulting (Inetum Consulting), infrastructure and application management (Inetum Technologies), software implementation (Inetum Solutions) and its own software publishing business (Inetum Software). Inetum has forged strategic partnerships with 4 of the world's leading software publishers - Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft and SAP - and is pursuing a dedicated acquisition strategy to become one of Europe's top 5 in these technologies, and offer the best expertise to its customers.

At Inetum Belgium, we offer more than just a job; we provide an inspiring environment and opportunities for growth and development. We strive to create a workplace where you can harness your talents, contribute to challenging projects, and be part of a leading IT consultancy group.

With a strong international presence, the organization collaborates with policymakers, industry leaders, regulatory bodies, and civil society stakeholders to address evolving economic and societal challenges. Its multidisciplinary approach combines analytical expertise, evidence-based policy development, and constructive dialogue to drive meaningful and lasting impact.

Jobomschrijving

As a Policy Officer your responsibilities are:

• Monitor and analyse European and international policy, regulatory, and market developments relevant to consumers and businesses.
• Conduct research and provide evidence-based analysis on economic, regulatory, and market-related topics.
• Translate complex policy, economic, and regulatory information into clear recommendations and strategic insights.
• Support the development and implementation of advocacy, public affairs, and policy initiatives.
• Build and maintain strong relationships with policymakers, industry representatives, regulatory bodies, and other key stakeholders.
• Represent the organization in meetings, conferences, working groups, and external events.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to maximize the impact of policy and advocacy activities.
• Prepare policy papers, briefing notes, position statements, and stakeholder communications.
• Support the planning and execution of stakeholder engagement activities and events.
• Identify emerging trends, challenges, and opportunities, and contribute innovative ideas to strengthen the organization's influence and impact.

A successful Policy Officer should have:

• Master's degree in Economics, Business, Public Policy, Political Science, or a related discipline.
• Relevant experience in public affairs, policy, advocacy, consultancy, regulatory affairs, or a comparable environment.
• Strong understanding of economic and market trends and their impact on consumers and businesses.
• Good knowledge of the European policy and regulatory landscape.
• Excellent analytical, research, and problem-solving skills.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics for different audiences.
• Proven ability to build relationships and engage effectively with senior stakeholders.
• Confident, proactive, and capable of representing an organization externally.
• Collaborative team player with strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
• Fluent in English; additional European languages are considered an asset.
• Innovative and solution-oriented mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities and challenge conventional thinking.

BelPro Chocolate Masters is a growing chocolate manufacturer in Duffel. We are looking for a motivated recent graduate or junior professional who wants to develop practical experience in Quality & Food Safety within a real food-production environment. 

You will work closely with the Operations Manager and experienced external specialists. You will support the development and day-to-day maintenance of our Quality Management System (QMS), HACCP, GMP, hygiene and food-safety activities. 

Your activities will include supporting procedures and quality records, following up quality requirements on the production floor, traceability exercises, internal checks, non-conformities and corrective actions, internal audits, supplier and raw-material documentation, and preparation for future IFS Food certification. 

We are looking for someone with a background in Food Technology, Food Science, Bioscience, Quality, Food Safety or a related field. Previous food-industry experience is an advantage but is not required. 

Good English is important. Dutch is an advantage. 

We offer a practical opportunity to learn, contribute and gradually take on more responsibility as BelPro continues to grow.

• Background in Food Technology, Food Science, Bioscience, Quality, Food Safety or a related field. 

• Basic knowledge of HACCP, microbiology, food safety, quality systems or food processing is an advantage. 

• Structured, practical and willing to learn. 

• Comfortable working both with documentation and on the production floor. 

• Able to communicate and cooperate with production and management. 

• Previous food-manufacturing experience is an advantage, but not required.
